skills.name: ytv-start
skills.description: Start or resume a ytvideos episode. Use for a new story/video request, an approved script, continuation, or a narrowly scoped edit; choose the channel and load the next task context.

skills.name: ytv-write-script
skills.description: Research and write a clear causal ytvideos script, adapt thumbnail hooks to verified story facts, and connect promise, opening, payoff and a natural Shorts loop. Use for research, script writing, factual checks or revisions.

skills.name: ytv-produce-video
skills.description: Produce an approved ytvideos script through AI-generated images and thumbnails, audio, subtitles and render; preserve exact inputs and the Shorts loop while packaging runs in parallel.

skills.name: ytv-review-video
skills.description: Review the exact ytvideos MP4, cold opening, payoff and Shorts loop; record checks and repair defects. When packaging is ready, check its card, tone and first confirmation before presenting the MP4.

skills.name: ytv-release-video
skills.description: Develop thumbnail hooks, AI composition drafts and full-card QA after script approval; perform an explicitly authorized YouTube release after exact MP4 approval. Use for packaging, metadata, upload and retesting.

skills.name: ytv-operate
skills.description: Inspect or recover saved ytvideos runs, leases, blockers, uncertain operations, worker capabilities, storage and budgets, including evidence-backed thumbnail experiment readback. Use for status, restart, cancellation and cleanup.

skills.name: ytv-maintain
skills.description: Change ytvideos code, profiles, documentation or project skills with bounded scope, contract tests and migration safeguards. Use for repository maintenance and onboarding a verified channel.
